item.content:encoded:
SLIP Lands a New Streaming Home: Everything to Know About the Acclaimed Parallel Universe Comedy Series

Fans of smart, genre-bending television have a reason to celebrate. SLIP, the critically acclaimed comedy series created by and starring Zoe Lister-Jones, is officially making its return to streaming. After its unexpected removal from The Roku Channel in 2023, the series has found a new home and is set to reach a wider audience.

With its unique blend of comedy, romance, and science-fiction elements, SLIP has earned praise from critics and viewers alike for its inventive storytelling and emotional depth.

item.content:encoded:
Billie Eilish’s Intel Pink: Everything We Know About Sarah Polley’s The Bell Jar Filming in Toronto

Billie Eilish is stepping into the world of feature films with her highly anticipated acting debut in Intel Pink, the working title for the upcoming adaptation of Sylvia Plath’s iconic novel, The Bell Jar.

Directed by Academy Award-winning filmmaker Sarah Polley, the project will film throughout Toronto during the summer of 2026. Combining one of music’s biggest stars with one of Canada’s most respected directors, Intel Pink has already become one of the most anticipated productions currently filming in North America.

Dwayne Johnson and Benny Safdie’s Lizard Music Lands at Amazon MGM Studios

Dwayne Johnson is taking on one of his most unexpected roles yet in Lizard Music, an upcoming film directed by Benny Safdie that has officially landed at Amazon MGM Studios’ United Artists.

With a unique storyline, a powerhouse creative team, and a fresh collaboration between Johnson and Safdie, Lizard Music is quickly becoming one of the most talked-about upcoming projects in Hollywood.

item.content:encoded:
After spending nearly a decade growing up on one of Netflix’s biggest television series, Finn Wolfhard is opening up about the emotional impact of saying goodbye to Stranger Things.

The 23-year-old actor, best known for playing Mike Wheeler, admitted he struggled with the end of the hit sci-fi series after filming wrapped on its fifth and final season. In a recent interview with The Guardian, Wolfhard described feeling “really lost” as he adjusted to life without the cast and crew who had become like family throughout his teenage years.
